steps.title: Model the split enclosure
steps.instructions: Reconstructed workflow from the published prompt and available result artifacts; this is not a recorded sequence of agent turns. Use the recorded dimensions, off-centre seam, printed pins, structural spine and underside panel. Represent the actuator and sensor as labelled reference envelopes.

steps.title: Export the manufacturing package
steps.instructions: Generate the assembly and individual parts as STEP plus printable STL/3MF, with editable source, BOM and assembly guidance.

steps.title: Verify digital geometry
steps.instructions: Use the validation report to check body and printer-bed bounds, seam gap, connected solids, spanning fasteners, pin clearance and actuator clearance; inspect assembled and exploded views.

steps.title: Keep the physical boundary
steps.instructions: The report validates geometry only. Printing, received-part fit, load, vibration retention, temperature and human-use suitability still need physical validation.
